info.title: fuaran-core-idl — the IDL stability classifier over two `idl.json` revisions.
info.description: Fuaran.Core.Idl.Cli — the IDL stability classifier as a command (`fuaran-core-idl`). Classifies the delta between two `idl.json` revisions: the wire severity per changed member with the reason it applies, the wire-profile evolution, and the F# consequence classes a consumer compiled against the generated structural layer meets. Exits 0 / 3 / 4 for absorbable / breaking / undecided, or asserts a declared class with `--expect`; `spike-proposal` prices a vocabulary-change proposal against a vocabulary. .NET-only and build-time; the classification it prints lives in Fuaran.Core.Idl.Codegen.

options.name: --manifest
options.description:
the vocabulary's manifest, read ONLY for its host roster (`hosts`).
Omitted, or without `hosts`, no host is obliged by name and the
report says so.

options.name: --expect
options.description:
assert the verdict class. Exits 0 on a match, 1 on a mismatch.
One of: unchanged | host-surface | additive | breaking | undecided

options.name: --support-before
options.description:
each side's declared support (support.json), both or neither: a doc
block, splice, case refine, kind projection or prelude that moved is
then a host-surface row instead of reading as `unchanged`.

options.name: --support-after
options.description: the other side's, with --support-before.

options.name: --idl
options.description: the vocabulary the proposal is priced against.

options.name: --corpus
options.description: the directory holding the `nodes/` family; without it the corpus leg

options.name: --out
options.description: write the report there instead of printing it.

options.name: --seed
options.description: the fuzz leg's seed (default 20260826).

options.name: --vectors
options.description: the fuzz leg's vector count (default 200).
